d: Short, light brown hair is styled in a bob with long bangs and two thin braids trailing down, tied with gold ornaments. The eyes are a muted grayish-blue with a cheerful, wide expression, set on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and petite. The outfit consists of a sleeveless white top with a black collar and trim, a high-waisted charcoal grey skirt with white horizontal stripes, and black fingerless gloves. Signature details include a black headband with gold characters and heavy, grey mechanical armor plating wrapped around the waist and hips.
